address: The Grand, 90 Federal Street, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: (The restaurant is temporarily closed.) Opened in 2014, Chef-owner Sid Sahrawat blends modern culinary approach with his Indian heritage and a band of loyal customers continue to show their support. His menu takes dishes from all regions of India, but with the addition of his own contemporary and creative touches. Most importantly, what always comes through is the quality of the dish’s main ingredient, be that delicious trevally or succulent duck.
